Overview of Basel-Landschaft Region (Basel-Landschaft)

Basel-Landschaft Region (Basel-Landschaft) is located in the Basel-Landschaft region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Allschwil. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Historic Altstadt / Old Town, Panoramic mountain & lake views, Marked SwitzerlandMobility hiking trails, Local heritage museum.

RegionBasel-Landschaft
Capital cityAllschwil
Cities & municipalities21
Primary transport hubAllschwil Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Basel-Landschaft Region

Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass. Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Basel-Landschaft

When visiting cities across Basel-Landschaft, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Cheese fondue
  • Raclette
  • Rösti
  • Bircher muesli
  • Swiss artisanal chocolate

Best time to visit Basel-Landschaft

Best time to visit Basel-Landschaft: Jun–Sep (summer trails), Dec–Mar (winter sports).
